data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the same order (origin, destination, dates, passengers/promo, Search, Select outbound and return flights) with matching parameters. It adds a trip_type parameter and omits fare_type and passenger_details, and its calendar and country-then-airport steps are somewhat generic, so it is slightly less buildable than it could be.
